fusions.name: Spat Jet
fusions.desc: Spits a jet of water into the first enemy in line for 5 damage, with a 30% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Held at Full Draw
fusions.desc: A jet of water that deals 32 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range, and ignores the target's armour.

fusions.name: Firing Line
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further. An escort of water fights beside you for 12 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Refracted Aim
fusions.desc: Your water damage cannot be resisted.
